title: Opening: name, birth and life in New Orleans
summary: Arnold gives her name, her birth date (1937) and place in New Orleans, and says she has lived there all her life.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Hi. Your name please? Abby Arnold.
Your date of birth and place of birth? September 25, 1937 in Baptist Hospital of New Orleans.
Have you been to New Orleans all your life? Yes. When did you first come to where there was such a folk music as New Orleans Jazz?
